recommendation: Keep this source change as-is. If the publisher later generates the search.html summary from the SearchParameter bundles, this hand-maintained table can be replaced, but the current source now satisfies the FHIR-34088 resolution for the built common-parameters table.
issue_request: FHIR-34088 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I R5 change request asking that SearchParameter canonical URLs be visible without requiring users to inspect download files, specifically in resource-page search parameter tables and the common-parameters table at search.html#table for rows that are SearchParameters.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly tagged with FHIR-34088 was found. Existing registry text and generated resource search pages already exposed canonical URL information, but the hard-coded common-parameters summary table in source/search.html still had no canonical URL column.
additional_context: source/search.html is the authoritative source for the built search.html summary table. SearchParameter is active in source/fhir.ini, and the Resource and DomainResource search-parameter bundles define the actual common SearchParameters. FHIR-I Confluence minutes confirm the 16-0-0 Persuasive vote, and Zulip search found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Updated source/search.html so the common-parameters table has a Canonical URL column populated for the Resource and DomainResource SearchParameter rows, with links to the generated search-parameter details. Search-control parameters remain in a separate four-column table with no invented canonical URLs.
source_changes: source/search.html: Added a Canonical URL column to the common-parameters summary table and populated it for Resource-content, Resource-filter, Resource-has, Resource-id, Resource-in, Resource-language, Resource-lastUpdated, Resource-list, Resource-profile, Resource-query, Resource-security, Resource-source, Resource-tag, and DomainResource-text.
source/search.html: Split search-control parameters into their own four-column table so non-SearchParameter controls are not assigned canonical URLs.
